title: Asahina Mafuyu — Ticket Serendipity〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to get here without getting lost. Thank you for looking up the best route from the station, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we got here much earlier than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's better than being late and having to rush over. I mean, I'm such a terrible runner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, where is the concert being held?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The hall itself is apparently to our left.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But this pamphlet says that the waiting line is straight up ahead from here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
It tells us exactly where to wait.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take a look at some of the booths on our way over?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They have so many different instruments here.

rows.Speaker: Clerk A
rows.Line: Here, try plucking this string using your pick.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Wow! Did you see that?
I got it to make a sound!

rows.Speaker: Boy's Brother
rows.Line: Yeah, I saw. But I know you can do better than that. Try plucking it harder next.

rows.Speaker: Clerk B
rows.Line: Oh, you were in your school's brass band?

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: Yes. I haven't played at all since high school, but I've been thinking about picking it back up again, since my children are all grown up now.

rows.Speaker: Young Man A
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you able to play that so well?

rows.Speaker: Young Man B
rows.Line: Because I work hard every day?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, are all these different sounds bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That means you don't need this synthesizer anymore, right? I'll hold onto it for now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My dad brought it back over for me today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now you can go back to writing lyrics and mixing songs without having to borrow K's.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What is this feeling that's stirring within my chest?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not sure, but...
I don't think they're bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
They have a piano over there that anyone can play.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Shall we try playing it like we did during Shibuya Festa?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, excuse me.
We'd like to try playing this piano.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What would you like to play?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The same thing we did that time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Playing an instrument like this really puts me at ease.)

rows.Speaker: Attendees
rows.Line: Such a beautiful song... I wonder what it's called?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
I wasn't sure I'd be able to play it properly, since it's been so long...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?! Where did all these people come from?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That was a surprise...
I didn't think people would start gathering around us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you...
For inviting me to play.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And the concert will be starting soon, so why don't we go line up for it?
